title: Delicate dandelion seed
prompt: Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): A single dandelion seed floating through the air, on a fully transparent background, for a cute mobile game. Below it a long, slender, thin pale-green-brown stalk ending in a tiny tan seed, drifting at a slight diagonal tilt. Light, weightless and translucent, nothing solid or filled-in, no cloud-like blob, no thick outline (only the thin stalk and the little seed have a fine dark-brown line). Gentle illustrated game-art style that still matches the rest of the monthly emoji set. No text, no background. Square 1:1 ratio.
